title: SQL-backed experiment IDs must be parsed with the shared validation helpers, not int()
answers: invalid experiment ID causes internal server error on search or trace delete
non-numeric experiment_id returns 500 instead of a clean invalid parameter error
how do I convert experiment IDs to int in the SQLAlchemy tracking store
body:
Symptom: Searching datasets, runs, logged models or traces, or deleting traces, with a non-numeric experiment ID (for example "12abc" or "") returns an internal server error instead of clear invalid-parameter response.
Root cause: mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:SqlAlchemyStore called bare int(experiment_id) in many methods (_search_datasets, _list_run_infos, _delete_traces, delete_experiment_tag, query_trace_metrics, and others), so ValueError/TypeError leaked. The old SqlAlchemyStore._parse_experiment_id staticmethod covered only some paths.
Fix pattern: Use mlflow/utils/validation.py:_parse_experiment_id for a single ID and _parse_experiment_ids for lists. Both raise MlflowException(INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE). Call them where int() was used.
Constraints: The helpers assume a non-None value; handle optional parameters before calling them. Do not add new bare int() conversions of experiment IDs in SQL store code. Gateway endpoint create/update in mlflow/store/tracking/gateway/sqlalchemy_mixin.py:create_gateway_endpoint and update_gateway_endpoint use the same helper.
applies: Any SQLAlchemy tracking or gateway store method that turns a request experiment_id into an integer column filter.
says: Searching runs or models with an alphanumeric experiment identifier shows an internal server error.
Deleting execution traces with an invalid experiment identifier crashes with a server fault.
Return a clear invalid parameter message when searching datasets with non-numeric experiment identifiers.
The experiment search bar crashes with error five hundred on empty experiment filter inputs.
Querying trace metrics with malformed experiment identifiers should report a clear validation error.
search: SQL-backed tracking and gateway stores must validate request experiment IDs using mlflow/utils/validation.py:_parse_experiment_id or _parse_experiment_ids instead of bare int(). Bare int() calls in mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:SqlAlchemyStore methods such as _search_datasets, _list_run_infos, _delete_traces, delete_experiment_tag, and query_trace_metrics leaked ValueError and TypeError on non-numeric experiment IDs, causing internal server errors. The shared validation helpers raise MlflowException(INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE) for single IDs or lists and are also required in mlflow/store/tracking/gateway/sqlalchemy_mixin.py:create_gateway_endpoint and update_gateway_endpoint. Optional parameters must be handled before calling the helpers because they assume a non-None value, and new bare int() conversions of experiment IDs must not be introduced.
